title: Number Our Days
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description:
Number Our Days | wisdom for aging, eternal perspective, gratitude, and victory over fear - Psalm 90:12

Life moves quickly, but God remains our dwelling place from everlasting to everlasting. In Psalm 90, we are reminded that our days are brief, our strength is limited, and yet our lives are never meaningless in His hands. Even as the years pass and the body weakens, the Lord calls us to live with eternal perspective and to remember that one day we will indeed fly away to be with Him.

Psalm 90:12 gives the prayer we need: "Teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom." Instead of surrendering to uselessness, guilt, self-pity, or fear, we can receive each day as God’s gift. We thank Him for past mercies, walk faithfully in today’s responsibilities, and look forward to tomorrow with hope. Clean hands, a pure heart, and a life submitted to God lead us into peace, purpose, and joy.
